title: Origin story: Luminara
description: Luminara was a deep-sea diver's daughter who followed the lights down too far and did not come back — not as she was. The abyss gave her its own light: a lantern that burns without fuel, showing truth instead of mere sight. She guides lost ships and lost souls alike, and her light has never gone out.

title: Ability profile: Luminara
description: Ranked abilities: Lantern-light — rank 100/100; Abyssal navigation — rank 99/100; Compassion — rank 97/100; Truth-seeing — rank 96/100; Endurance — rank 95/100.

title: Power ranking: Luminara
description: Powers: Her lantern shows truth, not just sight; The deep obeys her — pressure, cold, dark; She cannot be lost; the light always knows the way.

title: Stamina feats: Luminara
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Dove deeper than any and returned; Keeps the lantern burning eternally.

title: Crossover notes: Luminara
description: Luminara crosses naturally with: light in darkness, the abyssal glow.

title: Design notes: Luminara
description: Light as truth; the guide of the lightless places.

title: Generator record: Luminara
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Luminara's database.
